what: AC (LV) cable trenches from every inverter to its concrete flood-protection bund, drawn at project scale. A MODEL: stations and tracks derived from satellite imagery; inverter positions, routes and trench sections assumed from the owner design and planning values.
imagery_source: derived from Esri World Imagery z17 (Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics); no imagery in this file

provenance.bunds: estimated: 24 concrete bunds seen on Esri z17 imagery, two transformer skids in each; positions agreed by two independent scans within 6.3 m; sizes from by-eye extents (+/-1.5 m)
provenance.tracks: estimated: access tracks traced on Esri z17 imagery (GPU mask + thinning), snapped
provenance.rows: estimated: table strips from a GPU scan of Esri z17 imagery (pitch 26.5 m against 26.8 m planning), split where tracks cross
provenance.inverters: assumed: spread along rows by row length; each on the table end post beside the 2.5 m inter-row gap
provenance.routes: assumed: along the inter-row gap to the row end, 1.5 m past the table, along row ends or straight to the nearest track, along tracks, into the bund apron ring, then side entry; a leg that crosses a table is never offered
provenance.lengths: plan lengths (no measured ground: the R5 DTM tile for this site was not streamed in this lane)

cable_od_m.source: catalogue OD, owner's Cable Geometry app data-solar.js sc_al_ata_ac_400 (manufacturer datasheet); XLPE/PVC variant assumed equal

duct_od_m.source: cited: NSP/002 v5.0 Table 5, 96.5/90 smooth duct, one core per duct (S2 fit check 17.3 %)

group.source: owner design page station-geometry.mjs (trefoil); envelope = cable-trench-or-drill getGroupGeometry

group_w_m.source: derived: 2 x duct OD (getGroupGeometry trefoil width)

group_h_m.source: derived: duct OD x (1 + sqrt3/2) (getGroupGeometry trefoil height)

gap_m.source: owner design page station-geometry.mjs: clear group gap 100 mm

margin_m.source: owner design page station-geometry.mjs: +0.2 m total (100 mm each side)

bed_m.source: owner design page station-geometry.mjs: 50 mm bedding

depth_m.source: owner design page inverter-station.mjs buildStation: trench depth 0.9 m (to the floor)

cover_ref_m.source: cited: NSP/002 v5.0 Table 1, LV on agricultural land

planning_depth_m.source: planning parameter (MV trench, detailed design; reference held privately)

planning_gap_m.source: planning parameter (MV trefoil group clear gap; reference held privately)

width_formula: width = n x group width + (n - 1) x clear gap + 2 x margin (owner design page station-geometry.mjs); group = trefoil of three 96.5 mm ducts, one core per duct

cover_m.derived: 0.9 m floor - 0.05 m bed - trefoil duct group height 0.180 m

frame_note: nodes are WGS84 lon/lat to 1e-7 degrees
